capabilities: : Display sync status and file states
extras: Requires self-hosting a CouchDB server. End-to-end encryption is on by default.
intentEvidence: This plugin takes a narrower path: one CouchDB server, always end-to-end encrypted, as few options as possible
problem: Users need a reliable, private, and end-to-end encrypted method to synchronize their local Obsidian vault across multiple devices using a self-hosted server.

relations.evidence: CouchDB Sync is inspired by Self-hosted LiveSync by vorotamoroz, which proved that PouchDB/CouchDB replication makes a great Obsidian sync.

summary: A live synchronization tool that securely replicates Obsidian vault data to a self-hosted CouchDB server using end-to-end encryption.
